text:
morgan_fin: Heads-up: Vellum Labs (acct 6732) invoice INV-8891 failed during capture — PSP returned authorization_expired. Customer says their virtual card policy closed auth window mid-charge and wants to pay by wire.

sam_ops: Got it. Did the retry job run? I see 2 automatic retries tonight.

morgan_fin: Yes, retried twice at 02:10 & 06:40 UTC. Both got 402 / auth_expired. PSP logs show partial_auth then void.

elaine_support: Customer reached out — they can do a one-time wire but need our beneficiary name + tax id + remit instructions. @jenna_sales can you confirm PO/contract number to include?

jenna_sales: PO is PO-9981, contract signed 2025-11-03. Please include PO in wire remittance. I'll nudge the buyer.

morgan_fin: Sending standard wire template below. We'll need bank name, acct number, routing (IBAN/Swift), beneficiary legal name, tax id, and contact.

treasurer_bot: Compliance check: non-USD wire requires BEN/SHA instruction. Confirm currency and add KYC doc if > $100k. (auto-check)

morgan_fin: Customer payment is $48,200 USD. KYC not required. Need SWIFT + acct. Customer asked for invoice PDF with line items.

sam_ops: Attaching invoice now, will mark 'pending manual wire' and disable auto-retry for this invoice to avoid double charge.

morgan_fin: Wire template:
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Beneficiary address: 123 Folsom St, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA
Beneficiary tax ID: 27-1234567
Bank: FirstTrust International
Bank SWIFT: FTINUS33
Account: 00123456789
Routing/IBAN: US00FTIN0000123456789
Remittance: INV-8891 / PO-9981 / Vellum Labs (acct 6732)
```

elaine_support: Customer confirmed they'll initiate wire today and send confirmation email with txn ref. I'll keep thread updated. :thumbsup:

morgan_fin: Great — when received, pls forward copy of bank remittance advice to finance@redwood.com and update billing portal. I'll create manual payment record and clear invoice.

jenna_sales: FYI reached buyer, said treasury needs beneficiary tax id on invoice PDF — added now.

morgan_fin: Thanks. I'll follow up if wire doesn't show in 72h. Closing loop here.
